source: systemctl list-units tradebot_* --state=active on the trading host; risk caps read from the arguments of each running service, else from the config file it names (risk_cap / fallback_cap; target_vol = vol-targeted). Re-read on every daily refresh; differences are logged in changes.

systems.name: BCO Brent Trend
systems.mechanism: Daily Donchian-10 breakout, chandelier trailing stop

systems.name: WTICO WTI Trend
systems.mechanism: Same family as Brent, separate parameters

systems.name: DE30 Channel v9
systems.mechanism: Intraday rolling-channel breakout, M1 source bars

systems.name: NAS100 Swing Chan
systems.mechanism: 576-bar rolling channel, gated by a peer volatility-regime filter

systems.name: NAS100 Vol Brk
systems.mechanism: Volatility-expansion breakout (2.2x realised-vol ratio), same regime gate

systems.name: MR SPX500 Dip
systems.mechanism: 20-bar z-score oversold mean reversion, 2.5x ATR stop, 7-bar hold

systems.name: MR UK100 Dip
systems.note: Live and evaluating signals, but capped at zero: it will not size a position.

systems.name: VRP
systems.mechanism: Variance-risk-premium sleeve across NAS100, FR40, UK100, NL25, AU200, JP225, HK33
systems.note: 1.75% is a pooled cap across all seven legs.

systems.name: Gold Trend TSMOM
systems.mechanism: Three-speed MA crossover (10/50, 20/100, 50/200), long-only, 8% annualised volatility target, trades only above 1,000 NAV
systems.note: Sized to a volatility target rather than a fixed per-trade risk cap.

systems.name: XAUUSD POC Short v17
systems.mechanism: Volume-profile point-of-control / value-area and prior-day pivot resistance fade, short side only; on this netting account it borrows units from the gold trend sleeve's position rather than opening an opposite trade

systems.name: Metals Book
systems.mechanism: Trend book across the gold and silver crosses (EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD, CHF and others) and copper - never XAU_USD or XAG_USD, which four other systems hold. Every instrument runs its own one-position sequence (20-ATR stop, 576-bar cap); one live bet per metal at a time; the real positions mirror the admitted virtual trades
systems.note: 0.95% per position, with the whole book held under a 25% margin ceiling.

changes.note: gold short-side level fade, 2% cap; the gold trend sleeve now lends units to it while a short is open (net exposure unchanged for the account)
trend book over the metal crosses and copper, 0.95% per position; the account's XAU_USD and XAG_USD exposure stays with the four existing gold and silver systems
